services.name: Smokin' Eggfest River Cruise
services.desc: ⏰ Duration: 30 Minutes 🐊 A Scenic Journey Through Old Florida This 30 minute guided journey drifts through the heart of the Wekiva River, a designated Wild & Scenic waterway bursting with natural beauty and Florida history. Glide beneath ancient cypress trees draped in Spanish moss, spot turtles, alligators, and wading birds, and learn how this crystal-clear river has flowed from the Florida aquifer for thousands of years. Relax, explore, and reconnect with the wild side of Central Florida — this is the cruise that started it all. ♿ The Wild’s for Everyone! blurb: Guests experience guided river tours including wildlife watching, fishing, and nature exploration on the Wekiva River. Tours include day and night options, family-friendly eco tours for kids, and private fishing charters. The tours depart from Wekiva Island and showcase the natural beauty and wildlife of the river.
extraNote: If you’re unsure where to go, don’t worry — any Wekiva Island staff member will be happy to point you in the right direction. ☀️ Weather & Wildlife# The river runs on nature’s schedule. · If weather or conditions change, we’ll contact you to reschedule, issue a gift certificate for another day of adventure, or simply fully refund the booking ⏰ Life Happens — We Get It! · Cancel at least 48 hours in advance for a full refund. · And if the weather goes wild, we’ll happily reschedule or refund. 🌀 Cancellation Policy You can cancel within 48 hours for a full refund. · If bad weather rolls in, don’t worry — we’ll reach out to reschedule or issue a gift certificate for another day of adventure. ·
